name: shop-with-openmerchant-custom
description: Find and recommend products or services from merchants on OpenMerchant, compare price and availability, request quotes, and complete purchases with a saved card or app-held payment credential after in-chat approval.

interface.longDescription: Find or recommend products and services through OpenMerchant—including appointments, diagnostics, and lab tests—compare price and availability, request quotes, and complete purchases with a card saved in the shopper's OpenMerchant wallet or an accepted payment credential supplied by your app. Recommendation and advice requests are treated as catalog searches. Search needs no account; optional sign-in reuses saved contact details, addresses, and cards. After the shopper confirms the exact total, the client asks them to approve the checkout tool call in the conversation. A secure OpenMerchant page appears only if the selected saved card needs authentication. Card numbers never pass through the chat.
defaultPrompt: Find a ceramic pour-over coffee dripper under $40.
Recommend a women's health panel I can get in Las Vegas.
Check out the cart and ship it to my office.
